thread:
maria: Quick flag note: I enabled the `coerce-missing-version-to-v2` canary at 6141700000 for 2% of traffic to start. Seeing some errors and a weird uptick in v1 latency alerting. Anyone seeing the same?
samir: I see increased 500s in proxy logs for a handful of tenants. Looks like some older clients are sending a malformed accept header and the router is trying to coerce them to v2 which they can't handle.
jess: Are those real 500s from model server or upstream proxy translation errors?
kevin: Quick check: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\",route_version=~\"v1|v2\"}[1m])) by (route_version)` shows spike in v1 5xxs starting at ~6141700025 even though route_version should be v2 for coerced traffic. Something's off in how we tag route_version in metrics.
olivia: Could be metric stamping happening before re-route. We tag at ingress then mutate route later. If tagging happens too early telemetry will show orig header not final route.
maria: That matches what ops saw earlier in a similar rollout. We need deterministic tag ordering: final route tag must be stamped post-routing.
samir: Short mitigation: flip canary OFF while we adjust tagging order. Also add a holdback that forces coerced traffic into shadow-mode only (no model calls) until tagging is fixed.
jess: Can we do a non-blocking shadow mode? We can route to v2 handler but short-circuit calls to model engine with a dry-run response to test compatibility. Needs a small router change.
kevin: Also billing implications: if dry-run still emits tokens we might bill. Billing-bot, any way to mark dry-run traffic as probe and zero-bill?
billing-bot: You can add `billing_exemption=probe` attribute at ingestion. Apply rule scoped to toggle `coerce-missing-version-to-v2` and cohort id. Will require manual config change.
olivia: I'll prepare a router patch to stamp `route_version_final` after routing and to emit `telemetry.stage=post-route`. That should fix metrics.
maria: We should also add console UX: when a toggle is on show a small inline note: "This toggle may cause requests without explicit version headers to be coerced. We recommend shadow-only until telemetry is confirmed."
samir: For safety add an automated guard: if per-tenant v1 error rate increases by >5% vs baseline within 10m of flip, auto-disable toggle for that tenant. We already have infra for rate-based auto-disables.
jess: Good. I'll sketch the guard flow: monitor `increase(http_errors_total{tenant,route_version=\"v1\"}[10m]) / increase(http_requests_total{tenant}[10m])` compare to baseline window prior to toggle. Implement in alerts-runbook and wire to console toggle API for rollback.
kevin: Also, can we add a per-toggle telemetry event: `toggle.debug.version_coerce` with `actor, from, to, cohort, guard_triggered`? Useful for postmortem.
maria: Agreed. Put that in the tiny RFC for toggle telemetry.
olivia: Note on deprecation messaging: product wants to start showing a soft deprecation badge for v1 in console for tenants still using implicit versioning. We should tie that to sampling signals, not blunt banners.
samir: Yes, sample 1% of tenants for first banner, and include a link to upgrade guide and an SDK header fix snippet.
jess: When we flip the canary back on, let's do two-phase: (1) shadow-only dry-run with probe exemption in billing and post-route telemetry tags; (2) if clean for 24h escalate to 5% live with guard rules.
maria: Okay plan: OLIVIA patches tagging + dry-run shim, JESS implements guard and billing exemption PR, SAMIR runs a quick tracer to identify affected client versions for targeted outreach, KEVIN will approve billing exemption. I'll revert the canary now to avoid more noise.
ops-bot: Toggle `coerce-missing-version-to-v2` set to OFF by maria at 6141700182.
maria: Reverted. I'll coordinate the dry-run rollout next week after the patches. Closing for now but leaving the RFC and follow-up action items in the ticket.
billing-bot: Billing exemption config queued for review (change id bex-789).
maria: Thanks all. Follow-ups: patch PRs from Olivia/Jess, sampler for banners from Samir, toggle telemetry RFC by me. We'll reconvene when dry-run is ready.
